latest.title: Gastric distension after OHCA similar across airways
latest.finding: Median total gastric volume 594 mL; no significant gastric-volume difference between tracheal (n=87) and supraglottic (n=28) groups; CT-defined aspiration numerically higher with supraglottic airways (78.6% vs 57.5%, OR 2.7, p=0.071)
